messages:
Priya: Heads up — infra-eng candidate scheduled 12:00 PM PT tomorrow (resume: https://drive.redwood/recruit/infra123). @Samir flagged a conflict, need a quick cover or move?
Samir: Sorry all, I'm on a redeye. Can't make 12pm live. Can do async debrief notes afterwards but not join.
Elena: I can cover the system-design slot if it stays 60m and includes a design deep dive + short coding.
Aditya: I can take the coding exercise portion. Need the scoring rubric though — want to align on latency/throughput expectations.
Priya: Thanks — plan A: swap Samir -> Elena live, Aditya handles coding. Rubric link: https://redwood.company/interview-rubrics/infra (quick summary below).
Priya: Rubric TL;DR: Design 50% (architecture, tradeoffs, scalability), Coding 30% (correctness + clarity), Communication 20% (explainability, follow-ups). Please use note template.
Priya: ```Candidate notes template:
- Warm intro + role fit
- Design prompt + Qs asked
- Key tradeoffs + diagrams (if any)
- Performance considerations (latency, throughput)
- Coding notes + snippet
- Score: Design/Coding/Comm (0-5) + short rationale
```
Maya: Quick clarifying Q — does "Performance considerations" include cost/ops or only technical latency/throughput?
Samir: I'd fold cost into "practical constraints" inside Design. Score against Design bucket; annotate cost separately if it's a major risk.
People-Ops Bot: Reminder: debrief notes required within 24h or candidate status will move to "pending". :alarm_clock:
Katie: Sending calendar update and Zoom link now — booking #interview-room-3 for 12pm PT and inviting Elena + Aditya.
Elena: One candidate note — they mentioned timezone fatigue. Can we shave coding to 25m and give 35m for design?
Priya: OK to adjust: 35m design / 25m coding, still 60m total. Aditya, cool with 25m?
Aditya: Works for me. I'll keep the coding prompt tight and capture an annotated snippet in the notes.
Priya: Final assignment: Elena = design interviewer (live), Aditya = coding interviewer (live), Priya = debrief lead. Use rubric link and template. Ping me if any red flags during interview. :thumbsup:
Elena: Got it, will prepare 2 design prompts and bring a quick diagram.
People-Ops Bot: Interview roster updated: Samir -> Elena (live). Calendar invites updated.
